![](images/babyPHONO_logo_white.png){width="160px"}

Welcome to the babyPHONO research study website.

We are exploring how digital recordings of babies’ heart sounds could help improve the detection of heart problems in the future.

**This research does not change the baby’s usual clinical care.**

<br>
:::

## Participant Information {style="text-align: center;"}

<br>

::::: study-pathways
::: study-card
### Newborn baby check (NIPE)

For families invited to take part during their baby’s routine newborn infant physical examination.

We are investigating whether we can obtain good-quality heart sound recordings during the examination, and asking carers and clinicians about their experience.

[Read the NIPE study information](nipe-information.qmd){.study-link}
:::

::: study-card
<br>

### Echocardiogram (heart scan)

For families with a baby under 3 months already having a heart scan at the Jessop Wing as part of their usual care.

Babies may be eligible if a clinician has heard a heart murmur, or a previous heart scan showed a structural heart defect.

[Read the heart scan study information](echo-information.qmd){.study-link}
:::
:::::
